statement: The non-overlapping mask-stratified diagnostic MOP sample will reproduce cross-genome recurrence of identical token identities in the broad <=100-bp OUTSIDE_GENE boundary role above the independent-marginal token-identity null.
support_condition: S_pair_rep above null mean and one-sided 100,000-replicate Monte Carlo tail <=0.05; strong support <=0.01.
weakening_condition: S_pair_rep above null mean but tail >0.05.
contamination_boundary: Frozen before primary/diagnostic token-ID overlap was counted and before any diagnostic occurrence was recovered or annotated.
